conclusion.memoryRationale: The 4Gi fee-api default leaves headroom above the 1650.53 MiB local model-process peak for Node, the fee master, Python, and request concurrency.

limitations: This is a local Apple Silicon measurement, not Cloud Run production telemetry.
The three per-layer p95 values are conservatively summed and are not a substitute for end-to-end STG telemetry.
Controlled synthetic traffic does not establish customer copy-forward or routable rates.
